mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and 58 degrees at Harriet Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to 47 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing our Planning and Development Department. Also, if you need a scenic ride, the Senior Center is offering free rides on the Military Ridge State Trail via their tri-shaw bikes.

We have a busy couple of days! Today you can visit Insight Wellness for yoga, check out the Art Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360, or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Reflecting on the weekly recap, on September 21, officers identified a suspect who stole Swedish Fish from a retailer on East Verona Avenue and issued a citation for retail theft.
Our Culver's location is closed for the evening, but be sure to stop by tomorrow starting at 10 AM to enjoy the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor of the day.
